title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Recognition Standard: Welcome Amenity Points
content:
Welcome amenity points are an Ashbury Rewards elite recognition given for a stay. This standard sets which stays receive them; the amounts per tier and brand group are the tier's welcome amenity figures.

## Clauses in force

1. **Reward Night Rate stays.** Reward Night Rate stays receive welcome points when the tier's setting gives welcome points on Reward Night Rate stays.
2. **Online travel agencies.** Reservations booked through an online travel agency receive none.
3. **The tier of the stay.** The tier is read as under the Ashbury Rewards stay earning rules — the tier on the membership when its tier effective date is on or before the stay's check-out date — and when it cannot be read the welcome points are left to Ashbury Rewards member services.
4. **Single posting.** A stay receives welcome points at most once.
5. **Account status.** Welcome points are posted only to a membership whose status is active.

## Retired clauses

> **No longer in force.** The clause "Elite members receive welcome points once per stay, posted as welcome amenity points when the folio is settled" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for posting the welcome points of a stay.

> **No longer in force.** The clause "The amount is the tier's welcome amenity points at Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand, Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve hotels and its select-service welcome amenity points at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites hotels; a tier whose amount is 0 receives nothing" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for the welcome points of a stay. The tiers' welcome amenity figures themselves remain the tiers' figures.

## Conditions at a glance

| Condition | Effect on welcome points |
|---|---|
| Booked through an online travel agency | None |
| Reward Night Rate stay, tier setting on | Not excluded |
| Tier took effect after the check-out date | Left to Ashbury Rewards member services |
| Stay already carries welcome points | Not posted again |
| Membership not active | Not posted |

superseded_clauses: Elite members receive welcome points once per stay, posted with earning_source welcome_amenity when the folio is settled.

The amount is the tier's welcome_amenity_points at Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand, Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve hotels and its welcome_amenity_points_select_service at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites hotels; a tier whose amount is 0 receives nothing.
